     match mk with

     | MKArray n' a' values =>
         if (n' =? 64)%N
         then ⌜(bv_unsigned (Z_to_bv 64 (freeStackPointer args - freeStackBytes) + 8) - a') `mod` 8 = 0⌝ ∗
         ∃ i : nat, ⌜i = (bv_unsigned (Z_to_bv 64 (freeStackPointer args - freeStackBytes) + 8) - a') `div` 8⌝ ∗ ⌜(i < length values)%nat⌝ ∗
           ∃ Heq : 64%N = n', ∀ vmem : bv n', ⌜values !! i = Some vmem⌝ -∗ ⌜eq_rect 64%N bv n1 n' Heq = vmem⌝ -∗ a' ↦ₘ∗ values -∗ WPasm HIDDEN
         else ⌜n' = 8%N⌝ ∗
         ∃ i : nat, ⌜i = bv_unsigned (Z_to_bv 64 (freeStackPointer args - freeStackBytes) + 8) - a'⌝ ∗ ⌜(i + N.to_nat 8 <= length values)%nat⌝ ∗
           ∀ vmem : bv 64, ⌜vmem = Z_to_bv 64 (little_endian_to_bv n' (take (N.to_nat 8) (drop i values)))⌝ -∗ ⌜n1 = vmem⌝ -∗ a' ↦ₘ∗ values -∗ WPasm HIDDEN
     | MKUninit _ _ => False
     | MKMMIO a' length => ⌜a' ≤ bv_unsigned (Z_to_bv 64 (freeStackPointer args - freeStackBytes) + 8)⌝ ∗ ⌜bv_unsigned (Z_to_bv 64 (freeStackPointer args - freeStackBytes) + 8) + 8 ≤ a' + length⌝ ∗

     end)
